# revise task transform: take rare color object mask; find translations whose mask positions are all zero; color those
src='''from collections import Counter
def transform(grid):
 h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0]); counts=Counter(v for r in grid for v in r if v!=0); color=min(counts,key=counts.get)
 pts=[(i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if grid[i][j]==color]
 r0=min(i for i,j in pts); c0=min(j for i,j in pts); mask={(i-r0,j-c0) for i,j in pts}; mh=max(i for i,j in mask)+1; mw=max(j for i,j in mask)+1
 out=[r[:] for r in grid]
 for a in range(h-mh+1):
  for b in range(w-mw+1):
   if all(grid[a+i][b+j]==0 for i,j in mask):
    for i,j in mask: out[a+i][b+j]=color
 return out
'''
open(p,'w').write(src);exec(src);out=transform(grid);print(sum(a!=b for r,s in zip(out,grid) for a,b in zip(r,s)))
